_meta.status: APPROVED by the owner on 2026-11-05 (token sheet v2, then components, patterns and the shell through the end of Session 5). Source of truth for tokens; the foundation build generates core/ui/tokens.css from this file. Not product code. Components and patterns are described in docs/design-system.md.
_meta.contrastMethod: WCAG 2.2 relative luminance, unrounded. Gradients measured at the lightest stop.
decided: neutrals: COOL (2026-11-05), same lightness as the base warm greys, hue 255
corners: 0 tables and panes, 4 controls, 6 floating layers, full circle for avatars, dots, count badges
sidebar S1, phone header H1, avatar V4, button B0
progress fills: brown and olive both kept (2026-11-05)
office controls are ALWAYS 28 px with 13 px text, whatever the pointer; size follows the layout (office, phone under 768 px, floor device), never the pointer type (2026-11-05)
inputs, tabs, menu items and checkboxes 4 px; buttons 0 px; floating layers 6 px (2026-11-05)
one page treatment: every page fills the width with 24 px gutters; desktop forms open in a 520 px right panel (2026-11-05)
PIN is 4 digits everywhere, no lock-out, no delay, System Admin notified after 10 wrong tries, weak PINs allowed (2026-11-05, to be hardened later)
approvedWithSheet: input, tab and menu-item corners 4px (can be changed to 0 later, one value)
elevation values (judged on the sheet; revisit on real screens)
stillUnmeasured: Geist subset size against the 30 kB budget (owner declined the download; pin v1.8.2)
Base UI, Motion, Sonner, cmdk and the virtual list library against the 130 kB JS and 15 kB CSS budgets
press feel on a real phone and the press scale (0.98 drawn, 0.97 considered); contrast in bright light, kitchen reading distance
backdrop blur cost on weak devices
the 12 px tab labels and status text in sunlight; the 28 px logo badge on the sidebar
Lucide icon names and paths (written from memory, UNVERIFIED against the package)
full contrast table and size audit were skipped by the owner in Session 5

words.rule: One word, one tone, on every screen. Status is always dot (office) or icon (floor) plus the word, never colour alone.

text-faint.contrast: 5.2 on bg, 4.5 on the hover row

quiet-zero.note: zeros stay quiet but readable; base used #D2CFC9 at 1.5:1 which fails

border-control.contrast: 3.0 on bg and white only; 2.8 on zebra rows, so controls sit on bg or surface, never on striped rows

link.note: underlined ochre; base #B0610F measured 4.49 on bg and 4.22 on zebra rows, so it is darkened slightly

focus-ring.note: 2px ink ring with a 2px white gap, no blue

scrim.note: behind modals and the form panel; decoration, no text on it

sidebar.text: cream #F3EBDD 14.2:1, labels #CDBBA3 9.0:1 at the lightest stop

grain.note: dropped by owner 2026-11-05; add 1 to 2% only if banding shows on a real screen

gradient.rules: Gradients only on sidebar, phone header, section rules, progress fill. Never on buttons (B0 is flat), tables, charts, text blocks, floor lists, kitchen boards, disabled states.

progress-fill-brown.note: fill only, never text; start darkened from #D9A65E (1.7:1, failed 3:1)

progress-fill-olive.note: fill only, never text. Olive here is a display colour, it does not mean success; show the number beside the bar

gradient.progress-fill-rule: More fill colours may be added later; each must be 3:1 against the track (WCAG 1.4.11).

brand-moments-only.note: logo, login, loading animation, empty-state art, app icon, printouts. Never to mean a status.

font.pinned: Geist v1.8.2 (v1.9.x too new); 30 kB subset budget UNMEASURED

touch-min.note: phone and floor layouts only; the office layout is always 28 px (owner 2026-11-05)

pointer-min.note: office layout minimum; also the office control height

control.note: height of buttons, fields, rows of choice controls; size follows the layout, never the pointer
inputs, tabs, menu items and checkboxes (approved, kept 4 px on 2026-11-05)

full.note: avatars, status dots, count badges only

elevation.rule: Floor lists use borders, never shadows. Shadows only on floating layers. Values are PROPOSED, not yet judged visually.

glass.only-on: menus, popovers, toolbar, sheets, modals on office laptops
glass.fallback: solid #FFFFFF when prefers-reduced-transparency or no backdrop-filter

motion.stagger-ms: 30-80, max total 300, never on floor lists
motion.banned: ease-in on UI, transition: all, scale(0) entrances
motion.loading: no generic spinners; skeleton plus one signature animation after 300ms, held 500ms
motion.press-scale-note: 0.98 as approved on the earlier token board; guideline draft B1 said 0.97 (Emil). Decide on the prototype.

pin.submit: on the 4th digit, no Done key
pin.note: Owner decision 2026-11-05, to be hardened later. Reverses architecture.md section 8 (6 digits, five tries then 15 minutes). Risks in decision-log L.

layout.form-desktop: 520 px right panel, never a full page
layout.component-widths: field about 360 px, paragraph at most 640 px
